recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, tight-crop studio portrait of a man in formal attire, positioned off-center to the right, leaving a neutral gray negative space on the left for a two-tiered typographic lockup. The lighting is directional, emphasizing facial texture and sharp grooming.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed at the viewer to establish intimacy
Contrast between the dark vest and the light gray background
Juxtaposition of a geometric sans-serif logo with a fluid script subtitle
Tight cropping of the head and shoulders to create a sense of proximity
coreInvariants: Subject positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, subject occupies the right side of the frame from chest to crown, slightly cropped at the top and right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the hand adjusting the tie.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the hand/tie, then shifts left to the typographic lockup.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid flat gray area on the left side, providing a clean canvas for text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and subtle silver jewelry
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall; high value contrast between the black clothing and light background.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses wide, all-caps geometric forms
Subtitle uses a slanted, high-contrast copperplate-style script
Display text is framed by thin, L-shaped corner brackets
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' and 'E' in the display text feature horizontal bars that do not fully connect, creating a stencil-like or modernistic feel.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Modern geometric sans-serif paired with a traditional, elegant script for a balance of strength and sophistication.
graphicDevices: Thin L-shaped corner brackets framing the display text

preserve: The horizontal alignment of the text block
The contrast between the two font styles

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric, masculine feel of the display text.
Matches the elegant, high-contrast flow of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution studio portrait of a man with short hair and groomed facial hair, wearing a light gray dress shirt, a dark textured tie, and a black vest. He is adjusting his tie with one hand. The lighting is soft but directional, casting subtle shadows. The subject is positioned on the right side of the frame against a flat, neutral gray background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a two-line text lockup in the left negative space. The top line should be a wide, all-caps geometric sans-serif font framed by thin corner brackets. The second line should be a smaller, elegant script font positioned slightly to the right under the first line. All text should be solid black.

verificationChecks: Is the subject positioned to the right?
Is the background a flat neutral gray?
Are there two distinct font styles (sans-serif and script)?
Is the lighting emphasizing facial texture?

adjustableVariables: Font weight of the display text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the eyes and skin texture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the gray background.
Check that the subject's gaze is direct and engaging.
Verify the corner brackets are thin and do not touch the letters.
Confirm the script font is delicate and contrasts well with the blocky display font.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Asymmetrical Composition + [Geometric Sans-Serif] + [Elegant Script] + Neutral Palette
